query:
WITH swept AS (
               DELETE FROM class_course_subject
               WHERE class_course = $1
               RETURNING subject
           ), restored AS (
               UPDATE class_course
               SET subjects_inherited = TRUE
               WHERE id = $1
               RETURNING id
           )
           SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM swept) AS "swept!: i64",
                  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM restored) AS "live!"
